# Salwah Events and Catering (Salwah Events Ltd)

> Luxury 100% HMC Certified Halal Asian wedding catering (Bengali, Pakistani, and Indian), bespoke floral wedding stage decoration, and full event management across Greater London, Essex, and Kent.

- Business Name: Salwah Events and Catering (Salwah Events Ltd)

- Guest Capacity: 50–1,000+ guests (intimate Nikah & Mehndi to grand 1,000+ guest Walima banquets)
- Service Areas: Greater London (East, North, West & South London), Essex & Kent

## Packages & Pricing Summary
- Silver Package (£25 per person): Generous, crowd-pleasing Halal dining for Nikahs, Mehndis, Aqiqahs, and intimate receptions. Includes: 3 Starters; Fresh Salad & House Chutneys; 4 Main Courses (Chicken, Lamb, Vegetable & Daal); Pilau Rice & Plain Rice or Fresh Naan; 1 Traditional Dessert; Full Crockery & Cutlery; Professional Waiting Staff.
- Gold Package (£40 per person): Our most popular choice for full-scale wedding receptions and Walimas. Includes: Welcome Drinks & Canapés on Arrival; 4 Starters (Chicken, Lamb, Fish & Vegetable); Fresh Salad & House Chutneys; 4 Main Courses (Premium Selection: Chicken, Lamb, Prawn & Daal or Vegetable); Choice of Biryani or Rice & Fresh Breads; 2 Desserts; Full Crockery, Cutlery & Glassware; Experienced Waiting Staff & Floor Supervisor.
- Platinum Package (From £17,500 all-inclusive (200 guests)): Complete wedding catering, bespoke stage decoration, and full event management under one roof. Includes: Everything in the Gold Package for 200 Guests (Scalable to 1,000+); Full Event Management; Luxury Bespoke Wedding Stage Decoration; Venue Lighting & Full Room Setup; Live Dessert or Paan Stall; Centrepieces for Every Guest Table; Dedicated Lead Event Manager.

## Signature 100% HMC Halal Menu Highlights
- Starters: Chicken Tikka, Chicken Malai Tikka, Chicken 65, Chicken Dynamix, Lamb Kebab, Chapli Kebab, Vegetable Samosa, Papri Chaat, Chilli Paneer, Fish Masala, Chicken Drumsticks, Tandoori Wings
- Mains: Lamb Bhuna, Beef Bhuna, Beef Rezala, Beef Kala Bhuna, Chicken Roast, Chicken Karahi, Chicken Tikka Jalfrezi, Chicken Curry (On the Bone), Chicken Butter Makhni, King Prawn Jalfrezi, Prawn Saag, Mixed Vegetable with Prawn
- Vegetable Dishes: Mixed Vegetables, Saag Aloo, Saag Paneer, Paneer Butter Makhni, Aloo Baingan, Bhindi Dupiaza, Vegetable Manchurian
- Daal Dishes: Tarka Daal, Chana Daal Masala, Daal Fry, Makhni Daal, Chana Masala, Mung Daal Masala
- Rice & Biryani: Lamb Kacchi Biryani, Lamb Biryani, Lamb Pilau, Chicken Biryani, Chicken Pilau, Pilau Rice, White Rice, Fresh Naan
- Desserts: Kalajam & Ice Cream, Gulab Jamun & Ice Cream, Gajar Halwa & Ice Cream, Baklava & Ice Cream, Firni, Strawberry Cheesecake, Milk Cake

- The City Pavilion, Meridian Grand, The Willows, Mayfair Venue, Ariana Banqueting Hall, The Royal Regency, Palm Tree, Oasis, Osterley Park & House, Syon Park, and dry-hire estates across Essex & Kent.
